title: Make text and apps bigger
summary: Change the display scale in Settings so text and apps are larger.

steps.say: Press the Windows key and I together to open Settings.
hints: Hold the Windows logo key, then tap the letter I.
You can also open Start, type Settings, and press Enter.
steps.why: Settings is where Windows keeps almost every option.

steps.say: Click System, at the top of the list on the left.
hints: System is the first category in the left column.
Type display in the Find a setting box and pick Display from the results.
steps.why: Screen, sound and power options all live under System.

steps.say: Click Display, the first row on the right.

checks.prompt: Does the Settings page header now read Display, with a Scale option visible?

hints: Display is at the top of the System page, with a monitor icon.
Open the Display page directly from the Find a setting box by typing display.
steps.why: Text size and screen layout are set on the Display page.

steps.say: Under Scale and layout, click the box next to Scale.

checks.prompt: Is the Scale dropdown open, showing a list of percentages?

hints: Scroll down a little if you can't see the Scale and layout section.
Press Tab until the Scale box is highlighted, then press Space to open it.
steps.why: Scale changes the size of everything at once, not only text.

steps.say: Pick a larger percentage, such as 125 percent.

checks.prompt: Did the Scale value change to a larger percentage, with text on screen looking bigger?

hints: Higher numbers make things larger. The option marked Recommended is the default.
Use the up and down arrow keys in the open list, then press Enter.
steps.why: A bigger scale makes small text easier to read without changing resolution.

steps.say: Look around the screen. If it feels too big, pick a smaller value. Say done when you are happy.
hints: To go back, choose the value marked Recommended in the same box.
Some older apps only resize after you sign out and back in.
steps.why: The right size depends on your screen and your eyes, so try a few.
